principle: Teleon is a COMPILER for cognitive work: it takes an unbounded brute-force agent (correctness first) and runs OPTIMIZATION PASSES that progressively distill expensive general reasoning into cheap, deterministic, bounded execution (efficiency next) — the descent. This file is the single source mapping the canonical passes to our real descent AXES (architecture/descent_method_catalog.json), the REGISTRY each draws replacement candidates from, the MODULE that implements it today, and an honest status. The descent brain (descent_attempt_store) records every pass applied so the compiler learns. serves_truth=false.
